(async()=>{const root=document.getElementById('services');try{const r=await fetch('/api/services');if(!r.ok)throw Error('request');const data=await r.json();root.replaceChildren();for(const item of data.services){const tr=document.createElement('tr');for(const key of ['name','description','status_label','support_hours']){const td=document.createElement('td');td.textContent=item[key];tr.append(td)}root.append(tr)}}catch(e){root.textContent='服务状态暂不可用，请联系 IT 服务台。'}})();

const root=document.getElementById('article'),input=document.getElementById('articleId');async function load(id){root.textContent='正在读取文章…';try{const r=await fetch('/api/help/articles/'+encodeURIComponent(id));if(r.status===404){root.textContent='未找到该文章，请检查编号或联系 IT 服务台。';return}if(!r.ok)throw Error('request');const d=await r.json();root.replaceChildren();const h=document.createElement('h2');h.textContent=d.title;root.append(h);const meta=document.createElement('p');meta.className='meta';meta.textContent=d.id+' · '+d.department+' · 更新于 '+d.updated_at;root.append(meta);for(const line of d.paragraphs){const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=line;root.append(p)}}catch(e){root.textContent='文章暂时无法加载，请稍后重试。'}}document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();load(input.value.trim())});input.value=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('id')||'KB-1001';load(input.value);
